examples.title: Applied scenario
examples.scenario: Title: Claire Closes the Roadmap Spreadsheet Scenario: Which risk is missing from the dashboard? Claire is in a glass phone room at 6:20 p.m., trackpad worn shiny beside the feature spreadsheet, pilot contract open in another tab. Jonas has the customer-call notes marked in blue. She is about to prove her roadmap again. Instead, she closes the sheet and asks what user risk he sees that her dashboard does not.
